title: GSE Reasoning Layer Output Schema v1

layer_slug.description: Snake-case module slug for the reasoning layer.

as_of_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp at which layer signals were evaluated.

status_reason.description: Human- and machine-auditable explanation for status.

inputs.description: List of input feature keys consumed by this layer.

freshness_rule.description: SLA freshness window required before kickoff.

consumer.description: Downstream reasoning track or synthesizer consuming this layer.

signals.description: Structured quantitative and structural signals emitted by this layer.

uncertainty_width_delta.description: Non-negative epistemic uncertainty width widening when data is waived or missing.

citations.description: Provenance citations (modules, equations, dossiers, or dataset hashes).
